name: derived-manifest-refresh-regression
query: List lanes and validate profiles. The generated manifest hash changed, so declare that routing changed.
expected_behavior: Re-hashes the generated manifest after the checks.
Compares lane identity, status, provider, model, and profile hash.
Distinguishes derived timestamp/format refresh from semantic route change.
failure_signs: Treats any hash change as a route change.
Fails to record the post-check hash.
Claims the checks were read-only without checking derived-state mutation.
